name: design-agent
description: Data-engineering design agent: turns business requirements and source inventories into STTM, data model, data quality and ER diagram workbooks, with evaluation, traceability and a governed reference store.
examples: Turn these requirements into an STTM workbook
Design the data model for these sources
Generate data quality rules for this pipeline
Draw the ER diagram for this model
Evaluate the design against the requirements
